article.title: Fireflies公布新版Fred，把會議記錄延伸至跟進工作
article.title_en: Fireflies introduces a new Fred that extends meeting notes into follow-up work
article.summary: 新版把會議記錄、電郵、排程與連接應用納入同一工作環境，部分功能逐步開放。
article.summary_en: The new experience brings together meeting notes, email, scheduling and connected apps, with some capabilities rolling out in stages.
highlights: FredBots可用於定期整理客戶回饋等工作。
公司指Scheduler及Clips會分階段推出。
highlights_en: FredBots can take on recurring tasks such as preparing customer feedback reports.
The company describes a phased rollout for Scheduler and Clips.
article.why: 客戶管理團隊可從會議重點出發，把跟進事項轉成可核對的工作記錄。
article.why_en: Account teams can turn meeting takeaways into traceable follow-up records.
article.next_step: 先以一個非敏感會議測試任務整理，確認負責人、日期及來源能逐項對照。
article.next_step_en: Try a non-sensitive meeting and compare owners, dates and source notes line by line.
article.detail: Fireflies將新版Fred定位為跨應用工作助手，部分功能需要連接既有工具。公司列出可持續執行的工作例子，例如客戶回饋整理。公告另把新版體驗與各項功能的開放時間分開說明。正式連接前，可先限制資料與工具權限，並由團隊核對輸出內容與原會議紀錄是否一致。
article.detail_en: Fireflies positions Fred as a cross-app assistant. Some capabilities require app connections. Recurring customer feedback is one example. The company distinguishes the overall launch from individual rollout dates. Limit permissions first and compare outputs against the meeting record.
article.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
